name: magic-transition
label: Magic transition one-take (Zach King-style)
description: Single-take feel; a mundane setup transforms through a hidden cut (whip, lens block, object pass); SFX hit sells the magic; loopable end. Sound-off friendly.

sync.fillers: none; the illusion is the interrupt; hold 0.3-0.5 s after the reveal
sync.music: one light track; the transformation lands on a beat + SFX; brief silence just before the reveal
sync.transitions: hidden only: whip pan, body/object pass across lens, match on action

evidence: est. from public sources; calibrate with measured references
compliance_lock: never show an instant body or pain transformation (misleading)
